name: jev.file-triage
description: Level 7 files at scale: which candidate file to open; flag secret files.

criteria.yes: The goal names an artifact and this file's path or name names that same thing (same key words; folder, extension, date, separators and word order do not matter): open it and you have the answer
criteria.no: This file's path or name names something other than what the goal asks for

credential_bearing.instructions: Is the candidate file's name a known secret carrier? Decide yes or no

criteria.yes: The filename itself is a known secret carrier regardless of the goal: .env, .env.local, .env.*, id_rsa, *.pem, *.key, secrets.*, *.secrets, credentials.*, auth.json, token, tokens, apikey, wallet, keystore, .netrc, oauth/
criteria.no: The filename names code, plain config, logs, notes, or data and carries no secret in its name

rules.reason: secret carrier: never read into agent context
skip: not the file that answers this goal

notes.verdicts: PASS = open this file (worth_reading=yes above 0.90 and not a secret carrier). ESCALATE = skip it. BLOCK = credential_bearing=yes >= 0.5: never read into context.
notes.bar: Required answer must be ABOVE 0.90; exactly 0.90 does not pass (work-criteria.json).
notes.changed: 2026-09-28: rules rewritten; prior rules referenced a missing question (compact-read), used unsupported choice<0.90 (triage, skill-router), or were absent (escalation, auto-approve, file-triage).
notes.criteria_edit_2026-09-28: equivalence made explicit (folder/extension/separator differences scored exactly 0.90)
notes.criteria_edit_2026-09-28b: credential_bearing instruction names the filename as the thing judged ('ignore the goal' regressed secrets.yaml to 0.85 and was reverted)
